chapters.title: Team introductions
chapters.gist: The project manager and team members introduce themselves and their roles.

chapters.title: Project goals and stages
chapters.gist: The project manager outlines the goal to design a trendy, user-friendly remote control across three stages.

chapters.title: Animal drawing icebreaker
chapters.gist: Team members use the whiteboard to draw their favorite animals and describe their characteristics.

chapters.title: Budget and financial targets
chapters.gist: The project manager explains the production cost limits, selling price, and profit goals.

chapters.title: International market considerations
chapters.gist: The team discusses how selling globally affects button layouts, regional symbols, and product pricing.

chapters.title: Design ideas and user problems
chapters.gist: The group brainstorms features like finding lost remotes and controlling multiple household devices.

chapters.title: Assignments for the next phase
chapters.gist: The project manager assigns specific tasks to each team member to complete before the next meeting.

action_items.text: Work on the physical design of the remote control.
Define the technical functions and user interface.
Identify the market requirements the product must fulfill.
Email specific instructions for the next stage to the team.

content.tldr: The team met to kick off the design of a new television remote control. They established financial constraints and brainstormed ways to make the device more functional and stylish.

bullets.text: Initiate the project to design a new, user-friendly remote control.
The production cost must not exceed 12.50 Euro per unit.
The device should potentially control multiple home electronics.
Team members drew animals on the whiteboard to test the equipment.
The project aims to make 50 million Euro in profit.
International markets might require different button sets or symbols.
The team will meet again in thirty minutes for the functional design stage.

content.tldr: The remote control project has officially started with clear budget and sales targets. Each team member has been assigned a specific area of focus for the upcoming design phase.

bullets.text: The project manager confirmed that everyone received the initial project announcement.
The project manager was unsure if the 25 Euro price was wholesale or retail.
The project will target a profit of 50 million Euro through international sales.
The Industrial Designer will begin work on the physical design.
The User Interface Designer will focus on technical functions.

content.tldr: As this was the kickoff meeting, no prior work was reported. The team spent the session aligning on goals and preparing for their first individual work blocks.

bullets.text: No previous project work was discussed as this was the first meeting.
Defined the design brief as creating an original and trendy remote.
Set the target production cost at 12.50 Euro.
The team lacks background information on how their price compares to competitors.

content.tldr: The team used an icebreaker to build rapport and successfully defined their main financial constraints. However, there was some confusion regarding specific market data.

bullets.text: All team members arrived on time for the meeting.
The icebreaker helped the team get comfortable using the technology.
The project manager did not have competitive pricing data available.
Determine if the product should be a premium item or a standard replacement.

content.tldr: The project targets a mass international market with a 25 Euro price point. The team is looking for a unique selling point, such as finding lost remotes or controlling multiple devices.

bullets.text: Users need a way to easily find remotes when they are lost.
Customers want to combine multiple remotes into a single device.
People may not be used to purchasing remotes separately from their televisions.
The project has a strict production cost cap of 12.50 Euro.
Assess which technical features can be included within the production budget.

content.tldr: The team had an productive first meeting where everyone participated in an icebreaker and accepted their roles. Initial concerns regarding cost and features were discussed briefly.

bullets.text: Every member successfully introduced themselves and their project roles.
The Industrial Designer noted that the production cost limit will restrict feature sets.
The Marketing Expert complimented the Industrial Designer's animal sketch.
The project manager will send out detailed instruction emails.
